name: Talewyn Harbor
storyline:
Life in Talewyn Harbor begins with a fishing rod and an open world waiting to be explored. Arriving as a new angler, players build their own life in a living coastal community — catching fish, earning gold, improving their equipment and discovering new opportunities across the harbor and beyond.
As they progress, players can explore distant waters, sail boats, dive for hidden treasures, tame horses, gather resources, farm, craft, cook and establish their own homestead. The world is shared with other players, whose actions, trade and adventures help shape the harbor community.
Rather than following a fixed storyline, Talewyn Harbor lets each player create their own journey and decide what kind of life they want to build.
summary: Talewyn Harbor is a free-to-play multiplayer browser game set in a persistent coastal world. Players can fish, explore, sail, dive, gather resources, mine, cook, farm, craft, complete quests, tame and breed horses, and build and develop homesteads. The game features character progression, equipment upgrades, trading, multiplayer chat, changing weather and seasons, and a variety of activities and locations to discover. Talewyn Harbor can be played directly in a web browser without a download.
